- Annex VIII Section B points: 1, 3, 5, 2, 8, 4, 9.

Module B lists the same items, so the two modules agree on the listed data.

Sentence 1: both modules give the same restricted-registration rule, the secure non-public location, and the required, permitted and prohibited data rules. Both are full or near full. Both have the same coverage of annex points, areas and article references. A covers Annex III points 1, 6 and 7, and so does B. A also covers the areas and article references. They agree.

Sentences 2 to 5 are the listed data items. Neither module encodes the exceptions or the grouping into (a) to (d) separately; they use a flat list. Annex VIII points 1 to 10 with the exception of 6, 8 and 9 gives 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, and both modules list these. Both are therefore full or partial in the same way, and they agree.

Sentence 6: both modules have permitted access for the Commission and national authorities, and prohibited access otherwise. They agree.

Both modules mark sentences 2 to 5 as full, since the lists are present.
